products.name: Photoroom
products.note: AI photo editing; background removal; e-commerce focus; EU data handling

profile_text.body:
Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing tool and listing studio founded in 2019, aimed primarily at e-commerce businesses and social media creators. The company describes itself as helping users create product and portrait images using only a phone, with features including background removal, background replacement, object removal, clothing recoloring, image resizing, and AI-generated shadows. It also offers tools specifically oriented toward fashion and catalog production, such as AI fashion models, ghost mannequin, flat lay, and a product video generator.

For teams working at catalog scale, Photoroom offers an API, batch and bulk editing workflows, bulk background removal and resizing, and custom AI model support. The company describes its background removal as the fastest available and states it is trusted by more than 80 million users. A customer testimonial on the site references six-figure savings and a reduction of image workload to a quarter through automation, though Photoroom is the source of that claim. The site also notes EU data handling as part of its offering.

The held facts confirm Photoroom maintains a tracked product in the image and graphic design category, with the site verified as of August 2026. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data. The site additionally references a Photoroom MCP, noted as new at the time of the data harvest.
